acceptance_criteria: A gesture is one-handed or two-handed by a stated rule, and an attempt is only compared with examples of the same kind
A second hand visible only briefly during a one-hand gesture, and a hand lost briefly during a two-hand gesture, do not change the result; the limits are in milliseconds
Hands resting in view before and after the movement are not part of the gesture
The synthetic evaluation covers one-hand, two-hand and mixed profiles with these disturbances and prints measured numbers; no threshold is lowered to pass
A change that makes stored feature sequences incomparable raises FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: One-hand and two-hand gestures are told apart by rule and survive what a real camera does: a second hand passing through, a hand lost for a moment, and hands resting in view before and after the gesture.
planned_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
